register.title: Create a free account
register.subtitle: Manage your appointments in one place.

register.clinicSuccessToast: Your clinic was registered successfully and is awaiting verification from our staff. We'll notify you once it's approved.

registerClinic.approvalNotice: Your clinic appears in public search once an administrator approves it. Until then you can already add branches, doctors and services in your panel.
registerClinic.duplicateClinicName: A clinic with this name already exists.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you reset instructions.
forgotPassword.spamHint: If you don't see the email, check your spam folder.
forgotPassword.checkEmailBody: We've sent instructions to <0>{{email}}</0> if that address is registered.

resendConfirmation.title: Resend confirmation email
resendConfirmation.subtitle: Enter your account's email and, if it's still unconfirmed, we'll send a new email.
resendConfirmation.spamHint: If you don't see the email, check your spam folder.
resendConfirmation.checkEmailBody: If that address is registered and unconfirmed, we've sent a new email. Check your spam folder too.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a strong password for your account
resetPassword.successBody: Your password has been updated successfully. You can now log in with your new password.
resetPassword.tokenInvalid: This link has expired or is invalid.

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.subtitle: After changing it, all other sessions will be signed out.
changePassword.doesNotMeetPolicy: The password doesn't meet the requirements.
changePassword.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
changePassword.policyNote: Minimum 8 characters, with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number.
changePassword.successToast: Password changed successfully. Other sessions have been signed out.

confirmEmail.successBody: Your account has been activated. You can now log in.
